claims.text: This excerpt shows a series of log lines indicating instruction cache parity errors that were corrected on two different systems, R02-M1-N0-C:J12-U11 and R02-M1-N1-C:J12-U01.
The errors on R02-M1-N0-C:J12-U11 occurred over a period of several hours on June 15, with another error occurring on a similar system, R02-M1-N1-C:J12-U01, the following day.
A separate log line from a different system, R34-M1-N9-C:J07-U11, indicates a different event, generating core.16218, with no explicit connection to the cache parity errors.
